name: rocky shoreline
notes: Non-vegetated rocky sandstone shoreline abutting the Strait of Georgia. Submerged at high tide to 15+ meters wide at low tide. Dominated by Pacific rockweed and sea lettuce, with significant patches of red laver in the upper-intertidal. Supports a diverse array of intertidal sea life, including mussels, barnacles, fish, seabirds, and seaweeds.
